hero.title: Engineering the Systems That Power Our Future
hero.description: Behind every complex development is an intricate network of systems working in harmony. MENASCO brings together engineering expertise, technical precision, and coordinated execution to transform complex requirements into reliable, high-performance environments.

companyIntro.heading: Integrated MEP Solutions Built on Over Three Decades of Engineering Excellence
companyIntro.description: Established in the UAE in 1994, MENASCO is a multidisciplinary MEP contractor delivering integrated mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems for complex developments. With operations spanning seven countries, we combine decades of technical expertise with modern engineering practices to deliver reliable, high-performance infrastructure across diverse sectors.

servicesShowcase.heading: Five service areas, one integrated contractor
servicesShowcase.description: Select a service area to see how MENASCO delivers it, or explore the dedicated page for full capabilities.

mep.description: Mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection works form the core of our expertise and the foundation of our project delivery capabilities. Our experience spans the full project lifecycle, from engineering and BIM coordination through procurement, installation, testing, and commissioning, with particular strength in coordinating complex building systems across multiple disciplines and demanding project environments.
points: Water Supply, Drainage & Fire Protection Systems

civil.description: Civil and structural works are delivered in collaboration with our specialist engineering partners, allowing us to coordinate building infrastructure and MEP systems within a unified project scope. Our involvement spans design coordination, site preparation, structural interfaces, and construction sequencing, with particular emphasis on resolving technical dependencies between civil and MEP disciplines throughout project execution.

manufacturingPrefabrication.description: Our manufacturing and prefabrication capabilities, supported by specialized production partners in 3 countries, enable the off-site fabrication and assembly of MEP components under controlled conditions. By shifting selected construction activities away from the project site, we improve installation consistency, reduce on-site labor requirements, and support more predictable construction schedules through coordinated production, quality inspections, and delivery planning.

epc.description: EPC delivery provides a single point of responsibility for coordinating complex projects from initial design through construction and final handover. As the principal delivery contractor, MENASCO oversees technical coordination, specialist subcontractors, procurement, and site execution, aligning multiple disciplines under a unified project structure to maintain control over scope, cost, quality, and schedule.

dataCenters.description: Data center delivery requires precise integration of critical power, cooling, fire protection, and environmental control systems to support uninterrupted operations. Our capabilities extend across greenfield and brownfield developments, including facilities designed to achieve Uptime Institute Tier III and Tier IV certification, with expertise in a broad range of cooling technologies, from traditional air-cooled and chilled-water systems to advanced direct-to-chip (DTC) liquid cooling.

digitalEngineering.heading: Preemptive Clash Detection.
digitalEngineering.description: MENASCO's BIM & digital engineering unite every discipline in one model, identifying risks and resolving clashes before construction, and connecting design through to delivery.

prefabrication.heading: Manufactured with Precision.
prefabrication.description:
MENASCO’s off-site manufacturing & MEP prefabrication capabilities support faster, safer & more consistent project delivery. Through controlled production environments, we manufacture HVAC ductwork & prefabricate selected MEP components & modular assemblies in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications & quality standards.

By completing more work away from the construction site, we help improve quality control, reduce material waste and site congestion, minimize installation risks & accelerate on-site progress across large-scale and technically demanding projects.
prefabrication.mobileDescription: Off-site production of HVAC ductwork, prefabricated MEP components and modular assemblies in controlled environments, for faster, safer and more consistent delivery on site.

qualitySafety.heading: Quality, Safety & Environmental Responsibility at Every Stage
qualitySafety.description: Our internationally audited QHSE management system sets clear procedures, inspections and risk controls, driving consistent quality, safer sites and continuous improvement across every client engagement.

qualityManagement.title: Quality Management
qualityManagement.description: Documented procedures, material inspections, technical verification, testing & quality controls help ensure that every stage of delivery meets approved project specifications & client requirements.

healthSafety.title: Occupational Health & Safety
healthSafety.description: Risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, toolbox talks, training, site inspections & ongoing monitoring reinforce a proactive safety culture across our projects.

environmentalManagement.title: Environmental Management
environmentalManagement.description: Resource efficiency, responsible waste management, pollution prevention & environmental controls are incorporated into project planning & site operations to reduce environmental impact.
